description_en: Queries the details of a specified software prohibition policy
description_zh: 查询指定软件禁用策略的详情
name: GetProhibitedPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The software prohibition policy ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~): Lists software prohibition policies.
[CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~): Creates a software prohibition policy
parameters.help_zh:
软件禁用策略ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~)：批量查询软件禁用策略。
[CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~)：创建软件禁用策略
parameters.name: policy_id

Policy.description_en: The details of the software prohibition policy

AllowReport.description_en:
Indicates whether end users are allowed to submit a filing request for this policy. Valid values:
true: Filing is allowed. The terminal pop-up window provides a filing entry.
false: Filing is not allowed
AllowReport.description_zh:
是否允许终端用户对该策略发起报备申请。取值：
true：允许报备，终端弹窗提供报备入口。
false：不允许报备

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the software prohibition policy, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format using the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 软件禁用策略的创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用 UTC+8 时区

Description.description_en: The description of the software prohibition policy

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled. The policy is delivered to terminals and takes effect.
false: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to terminals
Enabled.description_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：
true：启用，策略会下发到终端并生效。
false：停用，策略保留配置但不下发到终端

ForceKill.description_en:
Indicates whether to forcibly terminate running software processes. Valid values:
true: The terminal immediately terminates the running processes of the software when the policy is triggered.
false: Running processes are not terminated. Only subsequent launches are blocked
ForceKill.description_zh:
是否强制结束已运行的软件进程。取值：
true：终端在命中策略时立即结束该软件正在运行的进程。
false：不结束已运行的进程，仅阻止后续启动

MainButtonTextCh.description_en: The Chinese text of the primary button in the terminal pop-up window
MainButtonTextCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗主按钮的中文文案

MainButtonTextEn.description_en: The English text of the primary button in the terminal pop-up window
MainButtonTextEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗主按钮的英文文案

MatchMode.description_en:
The policy matching target type. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Associates with all users.
UserGroupNormal: Associates with specific user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

MinorButtonTextCh.description_en: The Chinese text of the secondary button in the terminal pop-up window
MinorButtonTextCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗次按钮的中文文案

MinorButtonTextEn.description_en: The English text of the secondary button in the terminal pop-up window
MinorButtonTextEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗次按钮的英文文案

Name.description_en: The name of the software prohibition policy

ObjectType.description_en:
The object type of the controlled target. Valid values:
App: Controls by prohibited software. The controlled objects are specified by SoftwareIds.
Tag: Controls by prohibited software labels. The controlled objects are specified by TagIds. All prohibited software under the labels is controlled
ObjectType.description_zh:
管控对象类型。取值：
App：按禁用软件管控，管控对象由SoftwareIds指定。
Tag：按禁用软件标签管控，管控对象由TagIds指定，标签内的全部禁用软件均被管控

PolicyType.description_en:
The action type. Valid values:
Ban: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification to the end user.
BanSilent: Blocks the software from running without notifying the end user (silent blocking).
Warn: Displays a pop-up notification to the end user without blocking the software from running
PolicyType.description_zh:
处置动作。取值：
Ban：禁止运行并在终端弹窗提醒终端用户。
BanSilent：禁止运行且不提醒终端用户，静默阻断。
Warn：仅在终端弹窗提醒终端用户，不阻断软件运行

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级。取值范围：0~99，数值越小优先级越高

PromptCh.description_en: The Chinese prompt content displayed in the terminal pop-up window
PromptCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗的中文提示内容
PromptCh.example: 该软件已被企业安全策略禁止运行，如需使用请提交报备申请。

PromptEn.description_en: The English prompt content displayed in the terminal pop-up window
PromptEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗的英文提示内容
PromptEn.example: This software is blocked by your enterprise security policy.

ReportProcessId.description_en:
The approval process ID bound to this policy. An empty string is returned if no approval process is bound. In this case, filing requests submitted by end users are approved by the IT administrator as a fallback. Approval processes are bound by using [AttachPolicy2ApprovalProcess](~~AttachPolicy2ApprovalProcess~~) and unbound by using [DetachPolicy2ApprovalProcess](~~DetachPolicy2ApprovalProcess~~). You can obtain this value from the following operation:
[ListApprovalProcesses](~~ListApprovalProcesses~~): Lists approval processes
ReportProcessId.description_zh:
该策略已绑定的报备审批流程ID。未绑定审批流程时返回空字符串，此时终端用户提交的报备申请由IT管理员兜底审批。审批流程通过[AttachPolicy2ApprovalProcess](~~AttachPolicy2ApprovalProcess~~)绑定、[DetachPolicy2ApprovalProcess](~~DetachPolicy2ApprovalProcess~~)解绑。取值来源：
[ListApprovalProcesses](~~ListApprovalProcesses~~)：批量查询审批流程

SoftwareIds.description_en: The collection of prohibited software directly controlled by this policy
SoftwareIds.description_zh: 该策略直接管控的禁用软件集合

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the prohibited software is a system built-in entry. Valid values:
true: A system built-in prohibited software entry shared by all Alibaba Cloud accounts. Modification and deletion are not supported.
false: A custom prohibited software entry under the current Alibaba Cloud account
IsDefault.description_zh:
该禁用软件是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件

TagIds.description_en: The collection of prohibited software label IDs controlled by this policy
TagIds.description_zh: 该策略管控的禁用软件标签 ID 集合

TitleCh.description_en: The Chinese title of the terminal pop-up window

TitleEn.description_en: The English title of the terminal pop-up window

UserGroupIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs to which this policy applies
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 该策略生效的用户组 ID 集合
